lines.text: Maya kept her phone in her hip belt pocket on a freezing ridge.
At the junction she pulled it out for the map.
Cold makes phone batteries drain much faster.
Here's the fix. Keep your phone in an inside pocket, close to your body.
Turn on airplane mode when you're not using it,
and carry a small charged power bank.
Maya's phone lasted the whole loop.
Save this before your next cold hike.
